actions.name: admin_trigger_inference
actions.description: Trigger AI inference, either tagging or summarization, on bookmarks across the whole Karakeep instance. Filter by inference status and by how recently the bookmarks were modified. The inference jobs are queued and run asynchronously. Requires an API key owned by a Karakeep admin user; any other key fails with authorization_failed and carries the upstream 403 message Forbidden - Admin access required.

status.description: Filter bookmarks by their inference status. Use failure to retry only the failed ones.

success.description: Whether the job was triggered successfully.

outputSchema.description: The result of triggering an administrative background job.

actions.name: admin_trigger_recrawl
actions.description: Trigger a recrawl of link bookmarks across the whole Karakeep instance. Filter by crawl status to target specific bookmarks, for example only the failed ones, and by how recently they were modified. The crawls are queued and run asynchronously. Requires an API key owned by a Karakeep admin user; any other key fails with authorization_failed and carries the upstream 403 message Forbidden - Admin access required.

runInference.description: Whether to run AI inference after crawling.

modifiedWithinSeconds.description: Only process bookmarks modified within this many seconds. Must be greater than zero. Omit to process all matching bookmarks.

inputSchema.description: The options for the recrawl job.

success.description: Whether the job was triggered successfully.

outputSchema.description: The result of triggering an administrative background job.

actions.name: admin_trigger_reindex
actions.description: Trigger a reindex of bookmarks in the Karakeep search engine. Without modifiedWithinSeconds Karakeep clears the whole search index first and then re-queues every bookmark, so search results across the instance stay incomplete until the queue drains; with it only the bookmarks modified inside that window are re-queued and the existing index is preserved. The reindex runs asynchronously. Requires an API key owned by a Karakeep admin user; any other key fails with authorization_failed and carries the upstream 403 message Forbidden - Admin access required.

modifiedWithinSeconds.description: Only process bookmarks modified within this many seconds. Must be greater than zero. Omit to process all matching bookmarks.

inputSchema.description: The options for the reindex job.

success.description: Whether the job was triggered successfully.

outputSchema.description: The result of triggering an administrative background job.

actions.name: create_backup
actions.description: Trigger a new full account backup for the connected Karakeep user. Karakeep records the request and answers immediately with a backup whose status is pending; the archive itself is produced asynchronously by the instance backup worker, and assetId, size and bookmarkCount stay empty until it finishes. Poll get_backup until status becomes success or failure. When the backup worker is disabled on that instance the record stays pending forever, so always give the polling loop a timeout of its own. Karakeep rate limits this to five backups per hour.

actions.name: create_bookmark

anyOf.description: A note attached to the highlight, or null when the highlight carries no note.

note.description: The new note for the highlight, or null to clear the existing note.

inputSchema.description: Input for updating a Karakeep highlight.

bookmarkId.description: The id of the highlighted bookmark.

startOffset.description: The start offset of the highlight in the rendered content.

endOffset.description: The end offset of the highlight in the rendered content.

anyOf.description: The highlighted text, or null.
The note attached to the highlight, or null.

note.description: The note attached to the highlight, or null.

userId.description: The id of the user who created the highlight.

createdAt.description: When the highlight was created, in ISO 8601 format.

outputSchema.description: A Karakeep highlight on a bookmark.

actions.name: update_list
actions.description: Partially update a Karakeep list. Only the fields present in the input are changed, and sending null for description or parentId clears the stored value.

name.description: The list name, between 1 and 100 characters.

anyOf.description: A new list description of at most 500 characters, or null to clear it.

description.description: A new list description of at most 500 characters, or null to clear it.

icon.description: The emoji shown as the list icon in the Karakeep UI, for example a single book or star emoji.

anyOf.description: The id of the new parent list, or null to move the list to the top level.

parentId.description: The id of the new parent list, or null to move the list to the top level.

query.description: The Karakeep search query that populates a smart list, for example is:fav or #reading. Only qualified search terms are accepted.

public.description: Whether the list is publicly shared through a public link.

inputSchema.description: Input for updating a Karakeep list.

anyOf.description: The list description, or null.

icon.description: The emoji used as the list icon.

anyOf.description: The id of the parent list, or null for a top level list.

parentId.description: The id of the parent list, or null for a top level list.

type.description: Whether the list is manually curated or driven by a saved query.

anyOf.description: The saved search query for a smart list, or null.

query.description: The saved search query for a smart list, or null.

public.description: Whether the list is publicly shared.

hasCollaborators.description: Whether the list is shared with collaborators.

userRole.description: The role the connected user has on the list.

outputSchema.description: A Karakeep list.

actions.name: update_tag
actions.description: Rename a Karakeep tag. The name is the only field this endpoint can change, so it is required. The new name is trimmed and normalized, and every bookmark carrying the tag sees the new name.

inputSchema.description: Input for renaming a Karakeep tag.

name.description: The normalized tag name stored by Karakeep.

outputSchema.description: A Karakeep tag identified by id and name.

actions.name: upload_asset
actions.description: Upload a local transit file to Karakeep as a new standalone asset. Karakeep accepts GIF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, MP4, WebM, Matroska video, HTML, and PDF files, subject to the instance asset-size limit. The asset is initially detached; use attach_asset_to_bookmark to associate it with a bookmark.

fileId.description: The transit file identifier returned by POST /api/files.

name.description: Optional filename override to send to the provider.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override to send to the provider.

file.description: A file previously uploaded to the local transit file API. Optional name and mimeType overrides are forwarded to Karakeep.

inputSchema.description: Input parameters for uploading a file to Karakeep as a new asset.

assetId.description: The unique identifier assigned to the uploaded asset.

contentType.description: The MIME type of the uploaded file.

size.description: The size of the uploaded file in bytes.

fileName.description: The original file name of the uploaded file.

outputSchema.description: An asset uploaded to Karakeep.
